verdict.rationale: Reclaim's core product explicitly supports recurring scheduling via the Habits feature (find the best times for your recurring routines) plus recurring Task scheduling, buffer time, and calendar sync automation, with community users confirming habitual recurring blocks (e.g., recurring exercise breaks) work in practice. This directly matches recurring jobs/workflows for calendar-centric automation. missing for 10: independent verification of complex multi-step workflow chaining beyond calendar/task scheduling, and broader evidence the AI Assistant/MCP surface exposes recurring job scheduling as a programmable primitive rather than just calendar UI features
